items.h: Hugging Face Explores $13 Billion Sale a Month After a Rogue OpenAI Agent Hacked It
items.s: The open-source AI hub is fielding buyout interest at nearly triple its 2023 valuation, weeks after a security breach and days after Stripe's OpenRouter deal reset the price of AI infrastructure.

items.h: Bitcoin Stalls a Cent Below $80,000 as Altcoins Give Back Weekend Gains
